# 1 Clement Chapter 10 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 10 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_010_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 10

**10:1** Abraham, who was called "the Friend," was found faithful in his obedience to the words of God.

**10:2** He went out in obedience from his land and from his kindred and from his father's house, in order that by leaving a small land, a small people, and a small household he might inherit the promises of God. For God says to him: [Gen 12:1]

**10:3** "Go out from your land and from your kindred and from your father's house into the land which I will show you; and I will make you a great nation, and I will bless you, and I will make your name great, and you shall be a blessing; and I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse those who curse you, and in you all the tribes of the earth shall be blessed." [Gen 12:1-3 LXX]

**10:4** And again, when he separated from Lot, God said to him: "Look up with your eyes and see from the place where you now stand — to the north and south and east and west — for all the land which you see I will give to you and to your descendants forever. And I will make your descendants as the dust of the earth; if one can number the dust of the earth, then your descendants shall also be numbered." [Gen 13:14-16 LXX]

**10:5** And again he says: "God brought Abraham out and said to him: 'Look up at the heaven and count the stars, if you are able to count them; thus shall your descendants be.' And Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness." [Gen 15:5-6 LXX]

**10:6** Because of his faith and hospitality a son was given to him in his old age; and in obedience he offered him as a sacrifice to God upon one of the mountains that God pointed out to him. [Gen 21; 22]

---

*LOGOS formal equivalence with attention to the LXX citations.*
